root_cause_gate_evidence.decision_rule: When both declared raw-probe gates fail, all four pooled MLP held-realization AUCs remain in [0.40,0.60], and conditional expected ΔQ is state-dependent, classify observation information as insufficient.

protocol.rng_seed_rule: SeedSequence([20260925, realization, slot, draw_index]); independent arrival/request/workload streams; common task draws across heads/checkpoints at same realization/slot.
protocol.draw_0_reuse_proof: Reconstructed production replay is matched bitwise to saved raw_cache_context and the saved p_keep/p_update and delta-Q rows; candidate enumeration/probabilities are deterministically rebuilt from the exact frozen context, current hashed production source, fixed episode data, and checkpoint.
protocol.draw_generator: scenario.task_scenario.generate_tasks; rho_star fixed from the formal realization popularity.csv slot; only arrivals, service requests, input-size jitter, and workload jitter are resampled.
protocol.q_definition: For each draw, execute_slot/Matching/KKT computes KEEP and every legal UPDATE target; frozen pi_old(c|UPDATE) weights candidate Q_c; each branch uses reward + gamma * frozen critic value of its next observation.
protocol.adaptation: Starting K=4 including reused baseline; if abs(mean)>1.96*SE stop, else double to 8,16,32; never exceed 32.
protocol.outer_cv: Leave-one-training-realization-out, 4 folds; each head is evaluated separately for Ridge; pooled MLP includes 9-way head identity.
protocol.ridge_inner_cv: Within each outer-train split, leave one of the remaining 3 realizations out; choose alpha by mean validation MSE over [0.1, 1, 10, 100].
protocol.ridge_preprocessing: Per inner/outer fold, feature and target mean/std fit on train rows only; dual ridge solve; no held realization used for scaling or alpha selection.
protocol.mlp: raw_cache_context plus physical head one-hot -> Linear(409,32)-ReLU-Linear(32,1); 200 fixed full-batch NumPy Adam epochs, lr=1e-3, L2 weight decay=1e-3, seeds 20260925+fold; no held-realization early stopping.
protocol.held_realization_auc_not_single_fold_rul: At least 3 of 4 held-realization pooled MLP folds must have AUC >=0.60; this is used only with the user's pooled AUC and majority-head gates.
protocol.diagnostic_target: All 512 states retained; continuous target is conditional mean ΔQ even when K=32 sign remains unreliable.
